name: Ganzi
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: English Wikipedia, 'Baka language' (target of the redirect 'Ganzi language'), accessed 2026-09-17.
sources.note: Treats Ganzi (gnz) as one of the varieties of the Baka dialect cluster with Gundi and Massa, mutual intelligibility 'unclear'; the phonology section is about Baka proper and mentions tone (marked with acute/grave in the 2009 orthography) but says nothing about stress and nothing specific to Ganzi.

sources.citation: Ouzilleau, F. 1911. Notes sur la langue des Pygmées de la Sanga, suivies de vocabulaires. Revue d'ethnographie et de sociologie 2: 75-92. Ganzi = 'Vocabulaire II: Vocabulaire négrille des environs du village des Baya Buri de Bayanga (Kadeï)', pp. 82-83.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The only data for Ganzi are a ~110-item French-'négrille'-Baya wordlist in French practical spelling (e.g. 'Un bodé, Deux bidé, Trois pata, Eléphant ya'); the sole transcription note is 'Prononcez u comme ou et g toujours dur' (p. 81 n.1). Acute/grave accents mark vowel quality, not stress; no tone, accent or stress marks and no statement on prosody. The introduction (pp. 75-80) only relays Johnston's general remark that Pygmies speak with a 'singularly musical intonation' and 'staccato' syllable-timed pronunciation, said of the Ituri Mbuti, not of Ganzi.
